Indicators of Compromise: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution (CVE-2021-34473).

Method of Attack: Ransomware targeting Linux systems, with source code leaked on a hacker forum.

Method of Attack: Authentication bypass vulnerability allowing remote attackers to log in as administrators.
